---
name: "✨ Feature Request"
about: Suggest an improvement or new feature for CalradiaForge
title: "[Feature]: "
labels: ["enhancement", "triage"]
assignees: []
---

## ✨ Summary

A clear and concise description of the feature or improvement you are proposing.

> Example: "Add support for exporting modpacks as sharable preset files."

---

## 💡 Motivation / Use Case

- What problem does this feature solve?
- How does it improve your workflow or experience?
- Why is this important for CalradiaForge?

---

## 🧩 Detailed Proposal

Describe how you imagine the feature working:

- **UI / UX changes**  
  (New buttons, pages, settings, dialogs, etc.)

- **Behavior**  
  (What happens when the user interacts with it? Any edge cases?)

- **Configuration**  
  (New settings, preferences, or defaults?)

If helpful, include:

- Wireframes or mockups
- Pseudocode or high-level logic

---

## 🎮 Scope & Impact

- Is this primarily:
  - [ ] A UI / usability improvement
  - [ ] A core mod handling improvement
  - [ ] A game launching / platform integration feature
  - [ ] A diagnostic / logging / debugging enhancement
  - [ ] Other (please describe):

- Does this feature require:
  - [ ] Changes to modpack format
  - [ ] Changes to configuration files
  - [ ] New dependencies or tools
  - [ ] None of the above / Unsure

---

## 🔄 Alternatives Considered

Have you tried any workarounds or alternative approaches?

- Describe them briefly.
- Explain why they are insufficient.

---

## 📎 Additional Context

Anything else that might help:

- Related issues or discussions (links)
- Similar behavior in other launchers you like
- Potential risks, trade-offs, or concerns
